clips.title: The story
paras: Cyclonian is a mighty wind lord whose defeat has been sought for ages. To challenge him, a champion must gather the components required to summon the elemental and strike him down to claim his whirlwind heart. Defeating the wind lord allows the heart's power to be infused into a formidable weapon.

Cyclonian is a raging elemental wind lord whose presence commands reverence and caution. For ages, an attentive watcher has kept vigil over the summoning site, waiting for a combatant possesses enough raw martial prowess to challenge and destroy this tempestuous entity.

Calling forth Cyclonian requires a ritual of summoning using rare materials detailed upon a special parchment. Once summoned, the wind lord must be faced in direct combat, testing whether the challenger is truly a champion or merely another victim of his howling gale.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have spent ages watching this site. I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall. But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.
Prove it to me. Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great adventurer. Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.
If so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.
Here is a parchment with the items I need.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the items, friend? Gathering them is the proof I need that you have the strength to face Cyclonian.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have gathered the items for my spell, and have shown me your strength and cunning. But the next stage of our quest is even more perilous.
Let us hope your strength does not falter.
